row.notes: Bus message handler of the garage monitor container view model (vt 0x145760b60): Game_GarageMonitorContainerVM_OnActivate stores {0x141f79580, this} in a 16-byte closure (lea at 0x141f773e4) and subscribes it to car_monitor_fullScreen (key 0x1457550a0) with Ne_Subscribe_BusMessage 0x141f773ff; Game_GarageMonitorContainerVM_OnDeactivate loads the address again at 0x141f7885c. Body (pdata 0x141f79580-0x141f79684) read in full: rcx = container; picks the fullscreen variant into +0x944 (1 by default; when the dword [[[c+0x928]+0x40]+0x1a8]+4 is 15..17 and (byte +7 of Ne_Get_FeatureFlags has bit 3, or that dword is 0x12 or 1..14), from table 0x14576ebf8 indexed by dword +4 of the player entry [[c+0x928]+0x90]+0x68+16*Sess_Get_PlayerVehicleIndex, index <= 0x10), then Ne_UiEvent_DispatchByName(c, 'enter_fullscreen_mode', {4,0,0}, 0) and releases the returned ref; returns 0. It does not call Game_GarageMonitorContainerVM_SetViewMode itself: the switch to view mode 1 comes later through the container's command handler (vt slot 10, 0x141f74b60). rdx (the message) is not read. The red-flag-pit addon hooks it only to learn the container pointer. Strings: car_monitor_fullScreen 0x1457550a0, enter_fullscreen_mode 0x145760ca2.
